text: CHEXX (chexx.bet), the Crystal Palace sleeve brand, is owned and operated by Continent Gaming N.V., a Curaçao-registered private company (registration 159857) licensed by the Curaçao Gaming Authority, with Continent Gaming LTD in Cyprus acting as agent. Ownership is entirely private with no state stake. The record is opaque rather than abusive: CHEXX has been criticised as a thinly documented, Asia-facing operator behind a Premier League sleeve deal.
